newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield says Centremark lists in US.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield says Centremark lists in US.

text.p: Westfield Holdings Ltd chairman Frank Lowy said on Wednesday that Westfield America Trust's CenterMark Properties would be renamed Westfield America Inc and be listed on the New York Stock Exchange with an expected capital raising of US$400 million.

"Westfield America Inc will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange to raise funds for shopping centre acquisitions and redevelopment, the first of which will be an investment of US$145 million in Garden State Plaza in New Jersey," Westfield said. Westfield Holdings already has a 50 percent interest in the Garden State Plaza.
Westfield Holdings would grant Westfield America Inc options to buy 9.8 million or 10 percent of Westfield Holdings' existing shares for A$19.6 million at A$2.00 per share.
